title: Bulk Renewal Job Schema
description: Record of a bulk renewal job, its lifecycle state and processing statistics

id.description: ID of the bulk renewal job

status.description: Lifecycle status of the bulk renewal job

startedDate.description: Date and time when the job started

endedDate.description: Date and time when the job ended

totalEligibleLoans.description: Total number of loans eligible for renewal

processedLoans.description: Number of loans processed so far

failedRenewals.description: Number of loans for which renewal failed

reason.description: Reason the job was stopped or failed

metadata.description: Metadata about creation and changes, provided by the server (client should not provide)

_version.description: Record version used for optimistic locking, provided by the server
